_about: A gear shop: weapons, armor and charms. `stock` lists ids from data/items/equipment.json. The slice target is a real choice: the three shop weapons plus a pocketful of Ration Bars, but not every vest as well. Placeholder shop for the test room; the real Harrow shops arrive with M3-4.
name: Rivet & Stitch
greeting: Looking for something sturdy? Everything here has been hit with a hammer.
